definitions.explanation: A clear liquid coating brushed onto wood to protect it and give it a shine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ニス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}した。

ニス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}かないで→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't put anything on the shelf until the varnish is completely dry.

notes:
Shortened from English "varnish" (the ワニス form also exists but is rare). Used for wood; for metal or cars, ⟦{塗装|とそう}→塗装：06582_tosou⟧ (painting, coating) is the usual word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ニス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to varnish
- ニス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧: the varnish dries
- ニス{塗|ぬ}り: varnished; varnishing

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧: (house) paint
- ⟦{漆|うるし}→漆：10584_urushi⟧: lacquer
